title: Acton Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, walk-in centres, and essential supply points for Acton.
content:
For life-threatening medical emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals
- Charing Cross Hospital: Fulham Palace Road, London W6 8RF. From Acton Town station: ~15 min on the Piccadilly line east to Hammersmith, then a 10 min walk south along Fulham Palace Road, or take bus 218 south.
- Ealing Hospital: Uxbridge Road, Southall UB1 3HW. From Acton Central: ~4 miles west; take bus 207 or SL8 west along Uxbridge Road (~25-30 mins).
- St Mary's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Praed Street, London W2 1NY. From East Acton station: ~20 min via the Central line east to Lancaster Gate, then a 5 min walk north to Praed Street.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- Hammersmith Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Du Cane Road, London W12 0HS. From East Acton station: ~10 min walk east along Du Cane Road, or bus 7 or 70 east.

3. Local Hazard Notes
- Localized surface water flood risk along low-lying sections of the A40 (Western Avenue) and under railway bridges along Acton High Street during extreme downpours.

4. Essential Supplies
- Pharmacies and supermarkets along Acton High Street (Uxbridge Road), The Vale, and Churchfield Road supply water, basic first-aid goods, and medicines during outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
